author: claude
desc: CHEAP READ-ONLY RIG TASK to unblock 165 (macsmc battery/thermals). Everything else for the Linux apple,smc DT node is already captured from the ADT: smc 'iop,ascwrap-v6' at CPU-physical 0x50c600000 (mailbox base; raw ADT bus 0x30c600000 + arm-io ranges delta 0x200000000), interrupt-parent 242, mailbox IRQs 997/996/999/998, plus regs 0x50c050000 and 0x50c810000. THE ONE MISSING PIECE is the SMC SRAM carveout: the Linux node needs reg-names 'smc'(0x4000)+'sram'(~0x100000 = 1 MiB), and on t602x the sram sits at a SEPARATE base (0x2a3e00000, ~0x1a00000 above the smc base), not inside the ascwrap regs. The captured j614s-usb-port-map ADT does not expose it. TASK, over the running proxy (read-only, no writes, no reboot needed beyond reaching Running proxy): (1) with M1N1DEVICE set, in the m1n1 proxyclient shell, load the LIVE full ADT and dump /arm-io/smc and its 'iop-smc-nub' child completely, plus /chosen/memory-map, looking for an SMC/SRAM region ~1 MiB in size; (2) also check whether the ascwrap reg[0] at 0x50c600000 sz 0x88000 CONTAINS the sram (i.e. the Linux split may be smc=0x50c600000/0x4000, mbox=0x50c608000/0x4000, sram=some sub-offset) by comparing against how t602x maps its ascwrap-v6 to the apple,smc + apple,asc-mailbox-v4 + sram split. Cross-check the ranges delta on any address found (it should already be CPU-physical from the live ADT if using u.adt, or add 0x200000000 if raw). RECORD the sram CPU-physical base+size in ticket 165, then 165 can author the smc@50c600000 node (template t602x-die0.dtsi) and build the macsmc feature kernel offline. Suggested capture: save the full live ADT to a file (like j614s-usb-port-map was) so future offline work needs no rig. Evidence: done/2026-07-27-t6040-adt-ranges-address-correction.md (the +0x200000000 rule, confirmed on 4 nodes).
result: 2026-07-28 DONE via a caught dual-mode window (read-only). Saved the full live ADT to ~/Code/linux-build-out/j614s-full-20260728.adt (606208 B) — all future ADT/address work is now OFFLINE. SMC from ADT: /arm-io/smc iop,ascwrap-v6, mailbox cpu 0x50c600000 (sz 0x88000), IRQs 997/996/999/998, child iop-smc-nub. The SRAM is NOT an ADT reg and /chosen/memory-map is zeroed at this boot stage, so it is derived from the cross-SoC pattern: smc_base + 0x1a00000, sz 0x100000, constant across t8103/t600x/t602x/t6030. Inferred t6040 SMC SRAM = 0x50e000000 (0x50c600000+0x1a00000), sz 0x100000 — high confidence but flagged (t6040 base ends ...600000 vs others ...400000; wrong guess = safe probe failure, one-address fix). Evidence: done/2026-07-28-t6040-smc-adt-and-sram-carveout.md.
